what: Win probability of the chasing side, as predicted by the trained model. p values are tenths of a percent (0-1000), indexed p[overs_left - 1][wickets_in_hand - 1][runs_needed - 1]; null where the state can't happen. support has one digit per runs-needed value: 0 = fewer than 5 real training chases within 5 runs of the state, 1 = 5-24, 2 = 25-99, 3 = 100 or more.

model.name: ball_by_ball_win_probability
model.data: real Cricsheet T20 matches, men's and women's (conf/real.yaml)

assumptions.past: runs so far, runs and wickets in the last 30 balls: median of real men's training chases at the same over with the same wickets down; par pace (7.95 an over) where fewer than 10 chases exist
